issues.description: Mixed timezone-aware and timezone-naive datetimes are again handled inconsistently across filter operators. Equality and membership reject a mixed-awareness pair while ordering comparisons reconcile the same values before comparing them, so the result depends on which operator is used rather than on one coherent datetime-comparison policy. MetadataRouter and InMemoryDocumentStore both expose this filtering behavior through document_matches_filter, so the inconsistency propagates to higher-level components. The comparison policy should be consistent across operators, with strict mixed-awareness behavior available only as an explicit opt-in.
issues.repair_unit: apply one datetime-awareness comparison policy across filter operators and propagate an explicit strict opt-in through filter consumers
issues.mechanism_pattern: equality and membership reject mixed timezone awareness while ordering normalizes the same pair before comparison
issues.invariant_pattern: all filter operators must apply a coherent timezone-awareness policy to the same datetime pair
